verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Meltano is pip-installable, ships a prepackaged Docker container, and lets you host everything on your own servers free forever. Independent community posts corroborate this: one describes it as open source and self-hosted, and the GitLab Data Team reports running it in production. Missing for 10: in-depth production self-hosting operations guidance (scaling, upgrades, HA) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Meltano is pip-installable and comes in a prepackaged docker container
You host and manage everything on your own servers
Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.
Meltano is open source, self-hosted, CLI-first, debuggable, and extensible.
The GitLab Data Team is running Meltano in production.
